classification.difficultyReason: Convert the ball's diameter to its radius, calculate the cube and sphere volumes, then subtract and round.

content.prompt: A spherical soccer ball of diameter $22\text{ cm}$ is packaged in a box that is in the shape of a cube with edges of length $24\text{ cm}$. Find, correct to the nearest $\text{cm}^3$, the volume of unused space inside the box.

answer.worked:
The ball has radius $22\div2=11\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}V_{\text{box}}&=24^3\\V_{\text{box}}&=13824\text{ cm}^3\\V_{\text{ball}}&=\frac{4}{3}\pi(11)^3\\V_{\text{ball}}&=\frac{5324\pi}{3}\text{ cm}^3\\V_{\text{unused}}&=13824-\frac{5324\pi}{3}\\V_{\text{unused}}&\approx8249\text{ cm}^3\end{align*}$$
The unused space is $8249\text{ cm}^3$, correct to the nearest cubic centimetre.
